rows.relation: Physical cable economy
rows.where_it_enters: Placement or architecture objective after functional requirements are specified
rows.supported_result: Some biological layouts and model arrangements reduce wiring expense while retaining other constraints.
rows.unresolved_transfer: A CPU implementation pays for stored edges, memory access and communication, not imaginary cable length. A software benefit needs an actual cost mapping and matched computation.

rows.relation: Topographic similarity of learned response preferences
rows.where_it_enters: Joint task and spatial optimization; model responses change during training
rows.supported_result: Biological map/behaviour alignment and proxy energy or wiring can improve, with task-performance trade-offs.
rows.unresolved_transfer: These experiments do not hold our assigned semantic response roles fixed. Position initialization alone must be separated from later feature relearning.

rows.relation: Anatomical opportunity versus functional partner preference
rows.where_it_enters: Observed neurite overlap, contact conversion and connection strength
rows.supported_result: Functional feature relations can matter after accounting for selected anatomical opportunity measures; similar responses are not explained by soma distance alone.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Measured features, cell classes and sampling boundaries differ from fixed embedding coordinates. Association does not specify a candidate-generation or pruning algorithm.

rows.relation: Convergent paths induced by spatial wiring
rows.where_it_enters: Graph construction; geometry produces higher-order connectivity
rows.supported_result: One reported model loses recurring event reproducibility after degree-preserving random rewiring.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Degree preservation does not preserve convergent paths, modules or other motifs. The comparison supports a useful graph organization within its model family, not unique necessity of a physical metric.

rows.relation: Distance-linked delays and feature-organized waves
rows.where_it_enters: Connectivity construction, edge delays and ongoing propagation
rows.supported_result: Spatially patterned timing and gain can differ even when individual firing statistics are similar; feature-selective propagation has a positive model example with fixed sensory tuning.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The delay graph, feature map and degree budget must have an application meaning. Matching marginal delays alone does not preserve delays around paths or cycles.

rows.relation: Locality along dendrites or within a postsynaptic compartment
rows.where_it_enters: Synaptic integration and plasticity; receptor and compartment-dependent mechanisms
rows.supported_result: Input order, branch path and compartment can alter integration or potentiation, including causal interventions.
rows.unresolved_transfer: A receiver-specific dendritic relation cannot generally be collapsed into one global distance between source neurons. No branch state or extra bookkeeping has been authorized as a design.

rows.relation: Nonspatial sequence and assembly learning
rows.where_it_enters: Timing-dependent plasticity, competition, normalization and background input
rows.supported_result: Autonomous or transient organized dynamics can occur in models without a physical metric.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Dense candidate matrices, small networks, prescribed groups and additional stabilization rules limit transfer. Sparse final graphs do not prove learnability from bounded sparse storage.

rows.relation: Shared sensory subspace or semantic response geometry
rows.where_it_enters: Fitted stimulus-to-response descriptions and population comparisons
rows.supported_result: Shared represented dimensions coexist with distinct single-cell response profiles; semantic vector relations can predict responses.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Stimulus geometry is not anatomical geometry. Population alignment and single-neuron tuning do not determine a neuron-placement metric or synapse probability.

rows.relation: Topology of population states
rows.where_it_enters: Low-dimensional neural-state manifolds and dynamics over represented variables
rows.supported_result: Heading and navigation circuits can exhibit ring or toroidal population organization; some have causal functional evidence.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The topology belongs to represented states, not necessarily neuronal positions. A geometrically closed manifold does not itself establish ordered autonomous semantic loops.

rows.relation: Heavy-tailed strengths and finite connection capacity
rows.where_it_enters: Statistical graph observables versus storage provisioning
rows.supported_result: Pair strength can develop a heavy tail without identifying the distribution of distinct partners.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Allocated slots, live indegree, pair strength and synapse multiplicity require separate observables. Neither a tail fit nor a capacity template supplies physical distance.

rows.relation: Coordinate-free autonomous synfire rings
rows.where_it_enters: STDP, structural growth, normalization, inhibitory competition and per-neuron homeostasis
rows.supported_result: Small binary networks develop repeated propagation and switching without physical coordinates.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Dense E-to-I pathways, tested candidate density, learned rather than fixed semantic content and tight per-cell regulation require separate transfer evidence.

rows.relation: Fixed stimulus groups with cue-triggered replay
rows.where_it_enters: Random potential graph, synapse permanence, dendritic thresholds and group inhibition
rows.supported_result: A continuous-time HTM extension supports context-specific autonomous replay after a cue.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Potential contacts are dense relative to our budget; parameter changes enable replay; dense coordinate inputs and sustained loops are not tested.

rows.relation: Sparse fixed graph with learned probe responses
rows.where_it_enters: Fixed random topology, synaptic updates and bidirectional weight normalization
rows.supported_result: Ordered followers can be elicited after unstructured-input training, with changing identities under continuing plasticity.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Periodic probes and frozen testing do not establish ongoing autonomous recurrence; reference initialization is dense; neuron roles are not assigned semantic coordinates.

rows.relation: Hard-budget partner exploration
rows.where_it_enters: Active-parameter updates and replacement of removed connections
rows.supported_result: Learning can explore previously absent pairs while keeping a hard limit on simultaneously active connection entries.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Supervised gradients, global/per-layer constraints, implementation sampling conventions and nonconnection memory do not transfer automatically to per-neuron slots or Hebbian SNN dynamics.

rows.relation: Temporally asymmetric distributed sequence storage
rows.where_it_enters: Weights between successive prescribed patterns on a sparse nonspatial graph
rows.supported_result: Cued sequence retrieval can work with mean degree200 in a40000-unit example without a physical metric. A follow-up controls speed and persistent/sequential mode with population-specific input.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Random independent patterns, constructed weights, activity functions, near-uniform degree and transient retrieval do not establish online semantic loops.

rows.relation: Fixed incoming slots with source-address replacement
rows.where_it_enters: Pruning and reassignment of weak active synapses
rows.supported_result: A hardware experiment learns useful partners from a larger candidate universe with fixed fan-in.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Teacher-driven feedforward classification, bundle constraints, feature-space receptive fields and analog hardware timing do not establish recurrent CPU behavior.

rows.relation: Developmental and molecular partner specificity
rows.where_it_enters: Cell-context-dependent contact formation, maintenance and inferred interaction hypotheses
rows.supported_result: Perturbations and distance-controlled comparisons show that soma separation alone does not explain all cortical wiring specificity; the direction of a similarity association depends on what is similar.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Molecular identity, lineage, cortical layers and anatomical opportunity have no validated mapping to fixed semantic coordinates. Targeted perturbations do not validate an entire inferred connectome.

rows.relation: Imposed geometric regularization with learned hidden roles
rows.where_it_enters: Distance-weighted task loss, biased structural proposals and freely learned encoder/decoder
rows.supported_result: Geometry need not pre-exist physically to serve as an effective artificial-network inductive bias. Controlled gains occur in studied settings, with failures and moderate effects also visible.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The model already fixes semantic roles. Benefit must be separated from heterogeneous penalties, proposal changes and learned role reassignment; CPU cost and autonomous recurrent semantics were not measured.

rows.relation: Macroscale geometric modes under observation and input constraints
rows.where_it_enters: Cortical-domain basis, coarse observation, driven field dynamics and non-local projections
rows.supported_result: Geometry captures much slow spatially coherent activity; specific non-local connections add information for some statistics and fast targeted propagation. Construction and observation choices affect relative performance.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No result supplies a physical metric for fixed semantic neuron roles within one CC. Noise-driven stationary fields and fitted spatial reconstructions do not establish autonomous semantic recurrence.

rows.relation: Learned basis on a fixed sheet and weight-sheet compression
rows.where_it_enters: Trainable feature projections or smoothness of incoming weight vectors
rows.supported_result: Topographic organization can coexist with preserved overall task behavior; smooth trained weights can be more compressible.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Fixed coordinates do not preserve fixed semantic roles. Neither basis reconstruction nor compressibility establishes a physical distance-dependent edge rule or autonomous SNN dynamics.

rows.relation: Fixed feature identity with graph-derived spatial placement
rows.where_it_enters: Feature-dependent graph generation precedes the optimization of displayed neuron coordinates
rows.supported_result: Assigned feature labels can coexist with organized maps; known visual feature relations supply structure before placement.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No intrinsic relation between Flash dimension indices is supplied, and post-hoc placement alone does not alter position-independent state updates.

rows.relation: Economy of developmental wiring specification
rows.where_it_enters: Restricted potential partners permit reuse of a finite molecular-address alphabet
rows.supported_result: The theoretical code needs fewer labels under restricted reach and repeated connectivity patterns; studied1D/2D scaling is similar at matched neighborhood size.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Potential reach differs from live degree and slot capacity. Address-count savings do not establish reduced total runtime storage or autonomous computational benefit.

rows.relation: Anatomical geometry as a prior for static connectivity
rows.where_it_enters: Measured cortical mesh supplies Laplace-Beltrami modes for a fitted static kernel
rows.supported_result: Substantial connectivity prediction beyond simple distance models, with reported held-out and graph-statistic controls.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No geometry is derived from assigned semantic roles. Kernel postprocessing and neuronal transition rules are separate from anatomical fit.

rows.relation: Topology-dependent propagation beyond physical distance
rows.where_it_enters: Multi-step pathways predict responses to direct brain stimulation
rows.supported_result: Search information and communicability explain variation beyond distance, including under cost-preserving graph controls.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Macroscale intervention does not uniquely identify a microscopic signaling policy, learning mechanism or autonomous semantic loop.

rows.relation: Signed effective interactions and differentiated dynamics
rows.where_it_enters: Anatomically masked effective weights in coupled oscillators, then reuse in a separate driven tanh reservoir
rows.supported_result: Positive cross-species modeling and memory-score results with substantial controls; human task gain is modest.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Statistical sign, diffusive suppression, synaptic polarity and semantic sign differ. Synchrony, bounded amplitude and stable active fraction require different evidence.

rows.relation: Physical opportunity versus selected functional influence
rows.where_it_enters: Segmentation contacts, local paired physiology and learned response relationships
rows.supported_result: Many anatomical contacts are not synapses; among local neurons, a minority of functionally correlated strong connections can dominate measured excitation.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The application has no anatomical contact graph. Response similarity cannot silently become a physical metric, and a metric derived from the same coactivity may only reweight the learning statistic.

rows.relation: Aggregate balance versus recurrent-mode organization
rows.where_it_enters: Modular coupling, inhibitory organization, nonlinear dynamics and self-coupling
rows.supported_result: Controlling global strength or a spectral summary does not uniquely control competitive modes, synchrony or periodic attractors.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Neither periodicity nor a moderate activation fraction alone demonstrates learned semantic recurrence. Existing numerical thresholds do not transfer directly to the sparse FP4 model.

rows.relation: Meaningful topography versus response-space dimensionality
rows.where_it_enters: Task-dependent cortical quantity maps, population covariance and statistical geometry estimators
rows.supported_result: Some abstract magnitudes have spatially ordered preferences; response geometry can remain high-dimensional on low-dimensional physical support. Different dimensionality measures can rank spectra differently.
rows.unresolved_transfer: A quantity’s semantic order is not an embedding-coordinate order. Neither high covariance rank nor a compact visualization determines physical positions, a distance kernel or a permitted encoding change.

rows.relation: Geometric locality, degree counts and recurrent motifs
rows.where_it_enters: Static Gaussian spatial graph construction and degree-preserving rewiring; separate multiscale dynamical models
rows.supported_result: One released spatial/null graph pair has exactly matched incoming/outgoing degree multisets while differing greatly in reciprocal pairs and geometric length. Locality can organize higher-order structure beyond degree.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Static motif enrichment is not a demonstrated semantic dynamics benefit. Geometric wire length is not automatically software cost, and a dynamical range sweep may also change total recurrent input. No physical metric follows from semantic roles.

rows.relation: Recurrence, temporal statistics and self-feedback
rows.where_it_enters: Task-trained dense reservoirs, multifractal spike statistics and experimentally manipulated cortical autapses
rows.supported_result: Recurrence can influence temporal statistics, bursting and coincidence detection; self-feedback is cell-class selective and physiologically distinct from ordinary nearby-cell connections.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Task-trained networks do not establish a locality benefit or arbitrary learned recurrent topology. Autapse prevalence is not a near-neighbor probability, and transient burst effects do not demonstrate autonomous semantic loops.

rows.relation: Measured influence, direct wiring and operating state
rows.where_it_enters: Ensemble perturbation experiments and linear recurrent-circuit response theory
rows.supported_result: Spatial compactness and tuning jointly affect measured influence. Feature-dependent inhibitory paths and gain can explain changes of response sign and range; exact strong-coupling theory and sparse controls support this distinction.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The studies begin with anatomical coordinates and measured tuning. Partial influence measurements do not uniquely identify a direct distance kernel, and optical exclusion radii are not biological forbidden neighborhoods.

rows.relation: Functional completion and distribution-dependent coordinate association
rows.where_it_enters: Causal recruitment of a population representation; conditional statistics of the actual Flash input table
rows.supported_result: A functionally selected cortical ensemble can recruit decodable unstimulated-cell activity. Flash coordinate correlations have reproducible but substantially token-distribution-dependent structure.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Driven decodable completion is not autonomous semantic recurrence. Input-coordinate association is neither intrinsic physical distance nor a learned neuronal response map; adopting any locality rule still requires its own value and acceptance argument.

rows.relation: Functional modules without spatial input
rows.where_it_enters: Longitudinal inferred activity graphs and subspace clustering of recorded neurons
rows.supported_result: Activity-derived groups can predict encoding differences and recover spatially organized cortical populations without giving the clustering algorithm physical coordinates.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Inferred modules and changing hub labels do not identify synapses, an anatomical degree law or a layout for assigned semantic dimensions. Functional membership can change while role identity stays fixed.

rows.relation: Observation-derived graph topology and conditional reconstruction
rows.where_it_enters: Correlation, partial correlation, lagged and derivative-based connectivity estimation
rows.supported_result: Reconstruction can be successful in validated sparse dynamical regimes, while inferred graph statistics also depend on estimator, timing, threshold and null model.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Functional small-worldness and pairwise dependence are not direct anatomical-distance evidence. Existing conditional successes do not validate the application’s full scale, signed roles or autonomous regimes.

rows.relation: Within-assembly amplification and open-chain replay
rows.where_it_enters: Recurrent versus feedforward connectivity and membrane-state recovery
rows.supported_result: Recurrent excitation can sustain propagation with weaker feedforward edges without assigning physical coordinates.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Open-chain, one-pass replay and its cumulative population approximation do not establish repeated autonomous semantic loops, overlap capacity or per-CC stability.

rows.relation: Dendritic grouping and functional reliability
rows.where_it_enters: Nonlinear joint integration of selected inputs and task-dependent plasticity
rows.supported_result: Detailed cortical plasticity improves assembly-sequence reliability, and a controlled classifier gains parameter efficiency from learned dendritic input organization.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Neither establishes physical distance between assigned semantic-role cells. Dendritic state, learning rule and autonomous dynamics differ from the application and remain undecided.

rows.relation: Degree heterogeneity versus local edge dependence
rows.where_it_enters: Anatomical graph generation and matched structural nulls
rows.supported_result: Actual spatially constrained edge association exceeds a heterogeneous-degree control in the studied connectome; a geometric spread model captures several graph statistics.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Capacity is not actual degree, structural fit is not demonstrated recurrent computation, and the released spread algorithm differs from the printed rule.

rows.relation: Functional target selection followed by causal ensemble recruitment
rows.where_it_enters: Learning and intervention within fixed external response roles
rows.supported_result: Single-cell place-field induction and a few selected cortical targets can recruit wider functional groups; cortical targeting can change task behavior.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Physical opportunity, represented stimulus location, inferred graph relation and functional membership remain distinct. Driven recruitment does not establish autonomous cycles or semantic-role equivalence.

rows.relation: State-dependent event duration and memory benefit
rows.where_it_enters: Initiation, extension, termination and participant recruitment
rows.supported_result: Inhibitory subtype activity correlates with event duration, and separately timed causal ripple extension improves memory whereas interruption impairs it.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The observational subtype result does not identify the causal mechanism of the intervention study. Neither chooses a per-CC controller, duration band or physical-distance rule.

rows.relation: Learned ensemble availability and excitability-dependent allocation
rows.where_it_enters: Which existing cells cooperate during training and subsequent recall
rows.supported_result: Cortical imprinting adds spontaneously recurring ensembles; hippocampal excitation and silencing demonstrate context-dependent allocation.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Spontaneous events and day-scale excitability changes do not specify continuous semantic loops, fixed-role encoding or an anatomical metric.

rows.relation: Cortical priors as optimization constraints
rows.where_it_enters: Initialization, distance-weighted penalties and communication-distribution matching
rows.supported_result: The studied RNNs show positive learning benefits and can retain performance after graph-to-position reassignment.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Released scale/coefficient differences and evaluation provenance need reconciliation. Dense supervised hidden representations differ from fixed semantic SNN roles.

rows.relation: Structural correspondence versus dynamic identification
rows.where_it_enters: The relationship between wiring, neuronal parameters and desired trajectories
rows.supported_result: Known connectivity plus selected activity observations can constrain otherwise ambiguous single-neuron dynamics.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Known inputs, initial state and model class are important; the application needs its own functional observables rather than biological graph similarity alone.

rows.relation: Fixed input preferences with context-sensitive allocation
rows.where_it_enters: Learned recurrent cooperation and slowly varying excitability
rows.supported_result: A nonspatial rate model combines fixed feedforward preferences with cue-driven completion and temporally dependent ensemble overlap.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Nonpreferred drive, dense recurrence, silent gaps, excluded unstable trials and additional excitability variables differ from the application.

rows.relation: Learned spontaneous prior expressed as activity mass
rows.where_it_enters: Predictive plasticity, assembly-specific recurrence and inhibitory competition
rows.supported_result: A spiking model generates spontaneous ensemble firing whose total activity matches experienced stimulus probabilities.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Input roles are learned, and activity mass does not identify event frequency or ordered trajectories. Literal source equations and demo provenance require care.

rows.relation: Fixed whole-state preferences with learned stochastic transitions
rows.where_it_enters: Predictive recurrent learning and inhibitory balancing without physical coordinates
rows.supported_result: Fixed-input assemblies learn first-order spontaneous switching and temporal communities under constant background drive.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Whole-state nonoverlapping groups differ from shared semantic coordinates; higher-order context, gap bridging, sparse scaling and unrestricted transition coverage remain unresolved.

rows.relation: Population-pattern geometry and dynamical flow
rows.where_it_enters: Constructed recurrent modes and observation timescale, without neuron coordinates
rows.supported_result: Rate and spiking networks show internal oscillations or slow manifolds with weak or constant population-average changes.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Learned semantic content, activity-fraction semantics, sparse heterogeneous scaling and finite-precision dynamics are not established by the constructed low-rank examples.

rows.relation: Fixed observation versus learned temporal context
rows.where_it_enters: Distinct internal states and recurrent predictions for the same input meaning
rows.supported_result: Stochastic WTA models learn context-dependent sequence states and complete short cued sequences without a distance kernel.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Learned feedforward identities, ideal WTA normalization, dense coupling and optional global replay gating differ from the application. Fixed-role contextual learning remains an explicit open transfer problem.

rows.relation: Learning and recall dynamics matched to a trajectory objective
rows.where_it_enters: Local visible-weight updates, optional context states and modulated hidden-weight learning
rows.supported_result: Small models learn cyclic last-to-first recall and stochastic sequence distributions without physical coordinates.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Teaching/clamping, global modulation, synaptic kernels, binary coding and restricted examples differ from the application. No specific learning rule or new cell state is selected.

rows.relation: Learned directional propagation under a spatial input map
rows.where_it_enters: Distance-biased growth, asymmetric STDP, weight normalization and intrinsic/short-term plasticity
rows.supported_result: A cortical-sequence model connects learned forward weights to modest cue-order and spontaneous-transition changes.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Geometry and input trajectory are supplied together; no matched geometry-free benefit test, sustained semantic cycle or fixed-coordinate mapping is established.

rows.relation: Population regulation with heterogeneous individual responses
rows.where_it_enters: Diffusive or mixed local/global homeostatic feedback
rows.supported_result: Finite spiking simulations preserve response diversity and improve some rapid-input comparisons; a reduced nonspatial comparison captures part of the effect.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Finite-time and exact stationary claims differ, and released bounds/protocols matter. No homeostat, physical position or extra state is selected.

rows.relation: Population activity recovery and functional preservation are distinct biological outcomes
rows.where_it_enters: Homeostatic adaptation, intrinsic excitability and synaptic temporal filtering
rows.supported_result: Culture recordings show recovered population firing despite changing individual rates and unrecovered short-term facilitation; slice experiments identify activity-dependent intrinsic gain regulation.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Preparations, perturbations and timescales differ from a CC activity band. No specific controller, NO field, distance law or extra state is adopted.

rows.relation: Corresponding-group projections support denoising and competition without a neuron-distance metric
rows.where_it_enters: Fixed feedforward modularity and state-dependent recurrent E/I gain
rows.supported_result: Controlled spiking/rate variants improve noisy-signal reconstruction; two-input and inhibitory-rescue controls clarify the function.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Winner selection can discard legitimate simultaneous content; tested encodings differ from dense semantic coordinates. Readout alignment and fixed-projection assumptions remain. No geometry or denoiser is selected.

rows.relation: Outgoing contribution and joint-input computation differ from anatomical degree
rows.where_it_enters: Functional transfer-entropy edge gate and information decomposition
rows.supported_result: Observed outgoing degree associates with selected bivariate synergy; toy degree-aware rewiring can qualitatively reproduce the pattern.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Partial observation, pure-joint dependencies, common input and unmeasured anatomy prevent translating this into incoming capacity or a physical preference.

rows.relation: Continual nonspatial learning can maintain spontaneous assembly recall
rows.where_it_enters: Co-stimulation, opposing inhibitory plasticity and recall-versus-forgetting balance
rows.supported_result: Simulated modules and shared hubs persist during rest with plasticity active; larger and50%-connected controls remain positive.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Known-memory-count forgetting, sparse-scale gap, overlap and ordered cycling remain; exact source versions require care. No extra inhibitory taxonomy is adopted.

rows.relation: Degree heterogeneity, effective gain and stationary-rate closure are distinct
rows.where_it_enters: Recurrent feedback, endpoint sampling and plasticity-dependent rates
rows.supported_result: Controlled models reveal opposite oscillation effects and predict heterogeneous stationary distributions in specified regimes.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Capacity is not live degree; a stationary mean-field solution is not a stability theorem; weaker weights need not equalize rates. Fast coactivity cannot automatically be replaced by a slow rate trace.

rows.relation: Directed path organization affects feedback beyond average connectivity
rows.where_it_enters: Typed chain motifs, outlying modes and response timescales
rows.supported_result: Linear-network controls show mean connectivity alone can miss feedback and inhibitory responses; fixed-count scaling avoids growth of the tested outliers with N.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No motif-derived physical metric follows. Exact path identity, spiking nonlinearities, learning and semantic temporal fidelity remain outside the main result; second-order statistics do not determine every response.

rows.relation: Preserving learned structure during ongoing updates
rows.where_it_enters: Synaptic internal dynamics and bounded precision
rows.supported_result: Nonspatial multiscale synapses and reported recurrent retrieval controls provide positive memory mechanisms; finite-state theory exposes acquisition-retention tradeoffs.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Independent-input ideal-observer bounds and multi-variable synapses do not directly describe correlated sparse semantic cycling with one expressed FP8 weight. No extra state is adopted.

rows.relation: Low-precision learning without per-weight high-precision accumulation
rows.where_it_enters: Stochastic arithmetic, event scheduling and neural traces
rows.supported_result: Public source contains directly rounded FP8 plasticity; ideal stochastic rounding can avoid deterministic loss of sub-step increments.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Custom rounding can be biased, nonlinear firing changes its effect, and numerical resolution alone does not prove the desired RAM footprint or sustained semantic behavior.

rows.relation: Conditional interactions among synapses sharing a target
rows.where_it_enters: Local facilitation, heterosynaptic depression, consolidation and input selection
rows.supported_result: Perturbation experiments separate active signaling from obligatory resource consumption; timing and branch membership influence consolidation. A developmental model produces different functional groupings from different input ensembles.
rows.unresolved_transfer: These are target-dependent synaptic relations, not a global neuron-distance law. The application has no supplied dendritic coordinates, compartments, traces or reassigned receptive fields. Their functional benefit must be specified before introducing any counterpart.

rows.relation: Structural exploration and task-dependent retention without a physical metric
rows.where_it_enters: Synaptic-parameter dynamics, contact activation and reward/likelihood-based learning
rows.supported_result: Nonspatial spiking examples learn cross-modal association and a cue-triggered sequential action; one explicit inactive-contact approximation avoids continuously evolving negative parameters while retaining eventual performance.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The selected prior, fixed inhibitory scaffold, traces, potential-contact universe and hard capacity handling are separate assumptions. Parameter-space sampling is not evidence for the requested spontaneous semantic-state dynamics.

rows.relation: Population structure in connection-loadings space
rows.where_it_enters: Nonlinear recurrent modes, context-dependent gains and input routing
rows.supported_result: Nonspatial low-rank networks support stable oscillations and flexible tasks. Fixed input directions can coexist with learned contextual computation. Population-conditioned resampling preserves functions that global Gaussian resampling can lose.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The statistics and interventions can include reassigned input/output loadings. No mapping to existing semantic minicolumns, physical distance, static sparse capacity or discrete-state update semantics follows automatically.

rows.relation: Learned assembly sequences with imposed versus absent geometry
rows.where_it_enters: Recurrent learning, competitive activation and sequence recall
rows.supported_result: Fixed random input weights can coexist with learned replay; random-graph assemblies support composition and completion without neuron distance.
rows.unresolved_transfer: A physical grid, exact top-k activity, short-term synaptic states, control primitives and role reassignment are distinct assumptions. Neither model establishes the requested three regimes under the existing budget.

rows.relation: Tracer spatial density versus a pairwise distance kernel
rows.where_it_enters: Interpretation of anatomical locality measurements
rows.supported_result: Real cortical inputs are concentrated locally; the cited tracer study directly measures labeled-source density and FLN.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Finite uptake and available-source density separate these observables from neuron-pair connection probability and from any semantic-coordinate metric.

rows.relation: Cell-subtype physiology, incoming connectivity and initial response strength
rows.where_it_enters: Measured circuit influence beyond a scalar connection count or soma distance
rows.supported_result: Human temporal-cortex subtypes combine different incoming connectivity, excitability, initial response sizes and short-term dynamics. A high-input subtype can have smaller initial responses.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Measured EPSP is not the stored weight alone; subtype labels do not map to semantic coordinates. The released group distance control conditions on connection and is narrower than full pair-level adjustment.

rows.relation: Inputs converging on one receiving neuron
rows.where_it_enters: Target-local temporal integration and coordinated modification of existing effective connections
rows.supported_result: Mouse experiments show improved timing through convergent inputs and predictive peer timing for transmission changes, with recruitment, virtual-stimulation and held-out-assembly controls.
rows.unresolved_transfer: A shared target is not a global physical metric. Effective transmission, nonlinear integration and anatomical edge formation differ; shared optogenetic noise is not independently driven autonomous semantic recurrence.

rows.relation: Arrival timing relative to recurrent phase
rows.where_it_enters: Selection among fixed-delay connections through weight plasticity
rows.supported_result: Forward and feedback pathways can favor different delay ranges, with feedback tied to a resonant loop. A prescribed periodic spike-pair calculation makes the nonmonotone timing relation explicit.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Model-specific resonance, bounded weights and drive do not establish semantic-loop stability, physical coordinates or an approved delay-state budget.

rows.relation: Spatially coordinated directional pathways
rows.where_it_enters: A prescribed local connectivity field that supports moving population activity
rows.supported_result: Correlated directional bias produces spontaneous sequences under independent noise; symmetric and random-direction controls do not show the same propagation in the tested model.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The grid, local kernels and direction field are supplied, and detection uses that geometry. Contact multiplicity, drive and stimulus/background overlap limit translation to semantic recurrence or a distinct-neighbor budget.

rows.relation: Morphology-dependent contact opportunities beyond soma distance
rows.where_it_enters: Constructed axon-dendrite contact graph and its pruning into a structural network
rows.supported_result: A hybrid morphology control retains differences in directed-clique structure after matching placement and dendritic length; branch organization matters in the tested reconstruction.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Randomly pruned opportunities are not learned synapses or task acceptance. Exact published graph statistics have unresolved artifact correspondence, and clique dimension is not autonomous recurrence.

rows.relation: Correlated contact opportunity and selective survival
rows.where_it_enters: Potential contact multiplicity, contact-to-edge pruning and degree/distance-conditioned graph statistics
rows.supported_result: Anatomical reconstructions and targeted controls distinguish distance, morphology, pruning and placement of reciprocal edges; public-recording audit shows pooled neighbor enrichment depends on the conditioning reference.
rows.unresolved_transfer: These are structural endpoints with supplied anatomical coordinates. They do not specify semantic geometry, coactivity learning or a one-to-one mapping between contacts and compact slots.

rows.relation: Competitive recurrent learning with fixed feedforward tuning
rows.where_it_enters: Separate excitatory/inhibitory weight competition and learned recurrent influence
rows.supported_result: A fixed-feedforward experiment learns response normalization without assigning anatomical cell coordinates or relearning the input roles.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Dense continuous rate circuits with separate E/I classes and stimulus-specific training do not establish sparse FP4/FP8 autonomous semantic dynamics; suppressing weaker valid components may be undesirable.

rows.relation: Spine retention versus within-target coactivity clustering
rows.where_it_enters: Activity-conditioned synaptic survival and a receiving dendrite's local integration/plasticity signals
rows.supported_result: Longitudinal imaging links retention to activity and reveals increasing near-spine coactivity; model ablations separate response alignment from spatial clustering.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Distance belongs to supplied receiving branches; causal developmental mechanism and finite-network partner search remain unmeasured. Traces and replacement history exceed a single weight.

rows.relation: Nonlinear grouping reduces active-input requirements in a scoped cell model
rows.where_it_enters: Dendritic summation and calcium/NMDA activation, with matched input/volume identity and shuffled receiving positions
rows.supported_result: Approximately13% additional active inputs restore shuffled place-field firing; spatial information need not collapse, and the gain depends on input density and biophysics.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Prescribed post-learning single-cell inputs are not autonomous semantic recurrence. Active-contact savings do not equal allocated-slot or CPU savings.

rows.relation: Input concentration versus distributed nonlinear recruitment
rows.where_it_enters: Receiving-subunit thresholds, saturation, propagation and channel dynamics
rows.supported_result: Dispersed inputs can achieve sharp selective responses across several conductance combinations; small-cluster efficiency and whole-branch overload concern different operating regimes.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Neither study prescribes a monotone global distance preference among fixed semantic neuron identities; the computation and allocation scale must be stated first.

rows.relation: Task-defined adjacency with fixed input roles
rows.where_it_enters: Sparse recurrent communication allowed by the problem graph
rows.supported_result: Architectural locality can make a useful propagation solution learnable at adequate processing depth.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Semantic-coordinate numbering supplies no corresponding problem adjacency; reachability convergence is not autonomous cycling.

rows.relation: Lateral averaging and robustness of learned features
rows.where_it_enters: Prescribed channel-sheet mixing inside an image-trained network
rows.supported_result: Some profiles improve adversarial robustness while trading recognition accuracy and learning topographic feature organization.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Fixed semantic roles require a justified grouping; the study does not isolate2D geometry as uniquely necessary or test sparse recurrent semantic dynamics.

rows.relation: Anatomical geometry relative to fixed input/output locations
rows.where_it_enters: Signed-weight spatial-correlation regularizer in a dense parcel RNN
rows.supported_result: Faster learning than matched projection masks and stronger empirical spatial-subspace correspondence than retrained permuted geometries.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No neuron-level semantic metric; objective also biases direction/sign structure, and subspace variance does not establish temporal sequence behavior.

rows.relation: Reciprocity and restoration versus driven responsiveness
rows.where_it_enters: Directed support, weight normalization and input protocol
rows.supported_result: Conditional trade-offs between response separation, local restoration and label retention can occur.
rows.unresolved_transfer: One bias-supported fixed point is not an autonomous semantic cycle; fixed-edge reciprocity changes distinct-pair coverage.

rows.relation: Biological macro-topology and task-specific readout
rows.where_it_enters: Anatomical masks, signed weight assignment, input sites and readout modules
rows.supported_result: Some anatomical comparisons show useful structure near selected operating points; others match random reservoirs or depend on heterogeneous weight allocation.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No semantic-coordinate physical metric follows; memory endpoints, nulls and wiring proxies differ across studies.

rows.relation: Context-dependent filtering with fixed input identity
rows.where_it_enters: Recurrent state modifies later incremental responses
rows.supported_result: Designed cortical perturbations and a fixed-input/readout model support selective amplification and suppression of sequences.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Driven filtering, local learning and autonomous semantic cycling are separate requirements; no semantic-coordinate distance is supplied.

rows.relation: Transient excitability linking successive events
rows.where_it_enters: Input-specific priming/reset and coactivity across event ensembles
rows.supported_result: Behavioral/physiological evidence and a model support sequence association without physical-neighbor allocation.
rows.unresolved_transfer: CA3-specific pathways, additional state, orthogonal events and one-pass recall do not establish the proposed cortical semantic loop.

rows.relation: Local biochemical interaction between a target neuron’s inputs
rows.where_it_enters: Calcium diffusion, temporal overlap and plasticity thresholds
rows.supported_result: A supplied dendrite can support competition, cooperation and learned input-order selectivity.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Distance controls influence rather than a universal update sign; hidden compartment state and qualitative fitting limit direct transfer.

rows.relation: Functional recurrence with prescribed input preferences
rows.where_it_enters: Long-range connection selectivity alongside spatial kernels and E/I dynamics
rows.supported_result: One model accounts for multiple spontaneous and driven phenomena with some mean-activity-matched parameter controls.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Orientation maps have externally meaningful geometry; no equivalent distance follows from semantic-coordinate labels.

rows.relation: Input-source composition beyond local spatial spread
rows.where_it_enters: Brain-wide presynaptic identity and causal pathway contributions
rows.supported_result: Functionally distinct neurons differ in distant input composition despite similar tested local distributions.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Finite-power anatomical comparisons and rabies sampling do not identify a semantic partner rule or prove local equivalence.

rows.relation: Circuit-compatible distributed stimulation
rows.where_it_enters: Empirically inferred spontaneous patterns and their recurrent response
rows.supported_result: Endogenous patterns improve reliability and fidelity beyond matched spatial wavelength.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Covariance identifies preferred inputs only under additional assumptions; sustained stimulation is not autonomous persistence.

rows.relation: Timing-selective protection of overlapping assemblies
rows.where_it_enters: STDP weighting of common-input correlations
rows.supported_result: Near-odd windows suppress fusion-producing correlation terms under explicit homeostatic and weak-coupling assumptions.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Two-group weight persistence is not many-pattern sequence recall; causality alone does not ensure cancellation.

rows.relation: Context from recurrent history
rows.where_it_enters: Dendrite-to-soma transmission and a separate additive recall path
rows.supported_result: Same-component sequences can be distinguished and cued sequences completed without a physical layout.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Afferent roles are learned and substantial internal state is supplied; continuous cycling remains untested.

rows.relation: Rate and temporal coordination as complementary readouts
rows.where_it_enters: Pattern identity and familiarity decoding
rows.supported_result: Synchrony separates familiarity across varied drive while rate identifies supplied candidate patterns.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Prewired catalogue and changing graph degree do not establish fixed-slot learning capacity or semantic cycles.

rows.relation: Context-specific protection of dendritic learning
rows.where_it_enters: Externally selected inhibitory gating of compartments
rows.supported_result: Published abstract and source describe reduced interference between overlapping assemblies.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Full article access incomplete; context identities, compartments and feedforward learning require separate justification.

rows.relation: Distributed computational response roles
rows.where_it_enters: Match/mismatch responses to distinct learned associations
rows.supported_result: The same cells can carry different predictive-response classifications across stimuli, with indirect auditory-cortex evidence.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Normative learned input maps and single-association experiments do not define fixed semantic roles or autonomous generation.

rows.relation: History-dependent treatment of unchanged inputs
rows.where_it_enters: Recurrent context inference and nonlinear selection
rows.supported_result: ACC and a trained RNN selectively reduce irrelevant task information without a physical layout requirement.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Learned input weights, full training-set evaluation and conditional geometric arguments limit direct transfer.

rows.relation: Near-critical retention without anatomical coordinates
rows.where_it_enters: Symmetric linear recurrent dynamics, stochastic drive and trained delayed decoder
rows.supported_result: Long-lived modes and robust unknown-lag decoding can arise with fixed random recurrence; global covariance patterns survive several structural variants.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Retention is not autonomous semantic cycling; dense inhibition, fixed-role input mapping, finite states and noise objectives remain unverified.

rows.relation: Learned recurrent flow with fixed input/output maps
rows.where_it_enters: Predictive training on a circular moving-bump code and mixed-symmetry effective recurrence
rows.supported_result: Random initial recurrence can learn replay; task-aligned initialization improves reported outcomes without learning new input identities.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The ring is supplied by the task; dense rate dynamics, finite replay horizon and metric/formula qualifications prevent direct transfer to sparse semantic cycles.

rows.relation: Mixed response codes under explicit resource/noise objectives
rows.where_it_enters: Nonlinear feature conjunctions and response-space separation
rows.supported_result: Mixed codes can improve reliable decoding, with optimal mixing depending on population cost, feature fidelity and error objective.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Complete codebooks, ideal decoding and independent output noise differ from fixed signed roles and sparse autonomous dynamics; anatomical distance is not specified.

rows.relation: Compartment-local predictive substitution
rows.where_it_enters: Learning error and teaching protocol
rows.supported_result: Fixed outcome responses can train predictive cue responses without spatial neighborhoods.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Cue weights change; trace memory is pretrained and recurrent connections are not required for the main delay-conditioning result.

rows.relation: Incoming-drive compensation and representational diversity
rows.where_it_enters: Per-target input regulation
rows.supported_result: Activity fraction control can coexist with frozen cell selection; mean compensation prevents that effect under stated assumptions.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Heterogeneous semantic marginals and covariance require separate analysis; no controller selected.

rows.relation: Fixed channel groups with nonspatial structural adaptation
rows.where_it_enters: Recurrent partner selection and activity-dependent growth
rows.supported_result: Small reservoir benchmarks improve under fixed channel grouping and correlation-guided recurrence.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Quadratic search, continuous weights, supervision and driven tasks do not establish sparse autonomous semantic recurrence.

rows.relation: Context-dependent protection and reuse of cortical responses
rows.where_it_enters: Selective suppression and amplification of existing pathways
rows.supported_result: Mouse interventions support suppression of irrelevant responses and distinguish weak-evidence amplification from conflict handling.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Biological cell types and task-defined controls do not supply a physical metric or a selected CC controller.

rows.relation: Context inference with explicit information boundaries
rows.where_it_enters: Input routing, traces, gating and reward/change estimation
rows.supported_result: Computational models switch and retain tasks using learned contextual effects around stable components.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Task-indexed routing and separate estimators carry information not supplied by raw dense token vectors; code/version differences remain.

rows.relation: Local temporal credit assignment with transported teaching signals
rows.where_it_enters: Error pathway and retrospective/prospective neuronal dynamics
rows.supported_result: Online temporal learning and teacher-trained autoregressive prediction can work without anatomical partner distances.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Feedback symmetry, teacher availability, learned input maps, state precision and lateral recurrence remain distinct requirements.

rows.relation: Spontaneous assembly formation and changing membership
rows.where_it_enters: Covariance plasticity, normalization and background drive
rows.supported_result: A nonspatial dense model develops assemblies; a separate spatial variant produces spatially organized groups.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Stable group counts differ from stable content; geometry comparison changes size/parameters and does not test semantic performance.

rows.relation: Equivalent input roles and invariant recurrent responses
rows.where_it_enters: Weighted group-input sums and dynamical symmetry
rows.supported_result: Exact graph conditions preserve synchronized subspaces without coordinates; heterogeneous recurrence can separate same-role responses.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Invariance, attracting stability and nonlinear mean closure require separate conditions; no group compression or synchronization goal follows.

rows.relation: Spatial balance and admissible input profiles
rows.where_it_enters: Range of the recurrent operator, rate positivity and stability
rows.supported_result: Supplied geometry can constrain which inputs admit positive balanced rates; signed existence and biological feasibility are different.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The illustrated published/code discrepancy requires separating positivity from a claimed L2 divergence. No anatomical coordinates or phase controller follows.

rows.relation: Structured recurrence and high-dimensional response
rows.where_it_enters: Input/output subspace alignment, feedback sign and temporal spectrum
rows.supported_result: Low-rank recurrence can preserve high-dimensional driven responses, and local negative feedback can suppress coherent modes.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Strong asymptotic coupling, constructed geometry and continuous dynamics differ from fixed sparse semantic populations; response dimensionality does not validate semantic loops.

rows.relation: Learning, rate control and correlation regulation
rows.where_it_enters: Timing-weighted coactivity, recurrent feedback and adaptive inhibition
rows.supported_result: Nonspatial models and perturbation data distinguish correlation changes from stable average rates.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Partner allocation, broad degree, fixed semantic encoding and autonomous recurrence remain untested; inference of inhibitory changes is partly indirect.

rows.relation: Timing-driven reinforcement of prescribed assemblies
rows.where_it_enters: Balanced timing windows, recurrent covariance and faster stabilizing inhibition
rows.supported_result: Fixed-opportunity nonspatial models learn and maintain assembly weights, with pair/triplet and input-background conditions distinguished.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Structural partner selection, dense overlapping fixed semantic roles, finite degree and autonomous ordered cycles remain unresolved.

rows.relation: Conditional graph inference from small anatomical samples
rows.where_it_enters: Sampling geometry, reciprocity and second-order degree statistics
rows.supported_result: Simple proximity explains some enrichment, while directional and other residual structure requires additional explanation in the examined datasets.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Graph-family discrimination does not recover a unique circuit, establish useful dynamics or supply a physical metric for semantic assignments.

rows.relation: Human semantic tuning versus joint recurrent interaction
rows.where_it_enters: Fitted word-response geometry, pooled neurons and single-contact population signals
rows.supported_result: Single-cell semantic selectivity and context dependence have positive evidence; inspected maps organize words or response strengths.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Anatomical cell distances, joint coactivity, causal wiring and a fixed semantic-axis layout are not identified by those summaries.

rows.relation: Full positive/negative input-profile associations
rows.where_it_enters: Descriptive input-table covariance before an encoder or recurrent activity is defined
rows.supported_result: Signed and halfwave profiles give different rankings; full standardized profile geometry is high-dimensional.
rows.unresolved_transfer: A useful learning relation, temporal coactivity, anatomical metric and task-preserving local map are not determined.

rows.relation: Causal persistence and local functional influence
rows.where_it_enters: Hypothalamic ensemble perturbation and receptor-dependent dynamics
rows.supported_result: Selective pulse integration and receptor-dependent slow responses distinguish temporal maintenance from immediate decoding and gross activity.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The mechanism can include indirect or extrinsic signaling; no semantic geometry, valence drift or closed CC loop follows.

rows.relation: Locality combined with input alignment
rows.where_it_enters: Weak1D recurrent bias plus overlapping structured stimulus inputs
rows.supported_result: One fitted model preserves stimulus distinctions with shorter slow currents; a nonspatial longer-current model also fits.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Spatial and input/gain changes are combined, code/version details differ, and the fixed semantic-axis mapping is not supplied.

rows.relation: Distribution-dependent polarity associations
rows.where_it_enters: Halfwave token-profile correlation and descriptive partner ranks
rows.supported_result: Cross-spelling-group relationships differ more than disjoint within-group estimates.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Input weighting is not recurrent coactivity; no single natural metric or partner rule is identified.

rows.relation: Functional trigger and initial-state dependence
rows.where_it_enters: Targeted early/late motor ensembles under task engagement
rows.supported_result: Learned population patterns and movement depend on temporal role and initial context beyond measured target-location contrasts.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No pair-distance rule, isolated synaptic pathway or indefinitely recurrent semantic loop is identified.

rows.relation: Modular graph with resource-dependent communication
rows.where_it_enters: Controlled culture geometry and mean-degree-matched spiking topology
rows.supported_result: Asynchronous input changes cross-module burst propagation through topology and resource dynamics; geometry enters graph construction rather than the inspected dynamic equations.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Modules, additional states and noise conventions are supplied; learned semantic organization and application resource scaling remain untested.

rows.relation: Area-local plasticity versus distance-local selection
rows.where_it_enters: M1 plasticity manipulation and released functional analysis
rows.supported_result: Primary abstract supports a local-circuit learning contribution; released statistics characterize activity association.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Partial paper review cannot isolate recurrence or a physical-distance mechanism; inverse correlation is not synapse identification.

rows.relation: Local temporal modes versus aggregate persistence
rows.where_it_enters: Spatial recurrence, cellular persistence and input-dependent gain
rows.supported_result: Local correlations can change at fixed aggregate coupling; input/readout overlap matters even for identical graph spectra.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No mapping from semantic identities to spatial modes and no loop-memory contract are supplied.

rows.relation: Task-dependent degree and feedback effects
rows.where_it_enters: Data-informed laminar circuits and degree-preserving controls
rows.supported_result: Average performance can survive substantial rewiring while specific memory/rate tasks differ; feedback is beneficial for some tasks and harmful for others.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Richer state, selected tasks and trained readouts differ from fixed semantic coactivity learning.

rows.relation: Spatial shared variability and separated reservoirs
rows.where_it_enters: E/I rate fields or independently driven spiking reservoirs
rows.supported_result: Geometry and modular separation can alter dynamics and selected task performance, with noise and sparsity-dependent outcomes.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Neither temporal complexity nor ensemble accuracy establishes useful autonomous semantic recurrence at the fixed budget.

rows.relation: Observed persistence versus task-memory retention
rows.where_it_enters: Cellular temporal fits, task-conditioned history and temporal decoding
rows.supported_result: Different persistence measures have task/area-specific relationships; stable and dynamic representations can carry different useful information.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No measured decay statistic alone supplies semantic loop content, timing or a physical relation between fixed coordinates.

rows.relation: Broad temporal distributions and functional assembly size
rows.where_it_enters: Brain-wide fitted timescales and heterogeneous recurrent groups
rows.supported_result: Slow temporal diversity can arise through distinct model mechanisms; graph modes, cell observations and assembly dwell times must remain distinct.
rows.unresolved_transfer: No temporal tail exponent selects a sparse capacity exponent, a physical sheet or the current minicolumn grouping.

rows.relation: Fixed-input familiarity versus semantic recall
rows.where_it_enters: Hebbian recurrent weight learning and chosen temporal/rate readout
rows.supported_result: Continual recognition of input history can emerge without physical positions or changing input identity.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Driven familiarity classification with optimized parameters and dense connectivity does not demonstrate autonomous content cycles.

rows.relation: Sparse learning performance versus sparse execution
rows.where_it_enters: Random masks, preallocated connectivity, candidate proposals and simulator state
rows.supported_result: Sparse recurrence or rewiring can improve selected learning outcomes; preallocated dynamic connectivity is feasible.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Whole-pair state, padding, candidate exposure and training/readout assumptions must fit actual budgets; no application structures are adopted.

rows.relation: Material locality versus activity-dependent selection
rows.where_it_enters: Conducting-fiber hardware and derived benchmark simulations
rows.supported_result: Real hardware distances constrain growth, while activity-selected connections can improve small task-specific models.
rows.unresolved_transfer: The material constraint and the computational benefit are not isolated or supplied by semantic coordinate labels.

rows.relation: Content identity and conditional reinstatement
rows.where_it_enters: Fixed response preference, task context and learned temporal interaction
rows.supported_result: Stable content-selective responses can coexist with reinstatement that depends on context; overall activity and represented information need not covary.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Clinical task coding and temporal correlation do not supply individual anatomical distances or a causal synaptic rule for fixed semantic axes.

rows.relation: Delayed feedback and context-sensitive recurrence
rows.where_it_enters: Supplied layer roles, recurrent strength and task-history processing
rows.supported_result: Feedback, delays and recurrence can affect expected-input discrimination and contextual memory without a within-population physical metric.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Learned projections, unmatched load/regularization and abstract-only causal details limit transfer; printed projection bounds require correction.

rows.relation: Global geometric regularization versus metric necessity
rows.where_it_enters: Task-trained recurrent weight penalties and pruning
rows.supported_result: Some geometric coefficient structures improve sparse task accuracy beyond a matched coefficient histogram; global shape and task interact.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Hidden roles learn, nulls change symmetry/self penalties, and dense training/pruning differs from the fixed-role bounded model. No unique semantic topology is established.

rows.relation: Task-conditioned value of recurrent pathways
rows.where_it_enters: Which functional layers exchange present and delayed signals
rows.supported_result: Partial recurrence can preserve or improve useful behavior with fewer parameters; need for memory depends on sensory gaps and task.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Small learned pathways and normalized input sensitivity do not establish physical nearness, full CC semantic recurrence or CPU feasibility.

rows.relation: Task-induced functional modules versus physical neighborhoods
rows.where_it_enters: Learned context-dependent responses under supplied input geometry
rows.supported_result: Structured input can favor explicit or implicit specialization without an anatomical regularizer; transfer benefits depend on whether future contexts share rules.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Reviewedpreprintv2 learns hidden roles and supplies context; v3fulltext unavailable. No mapping to current minicolumns or recurrence is established.

rows.relation: Response constraints versus dynamical acceptance
rows.where_it_enters: Inferring allowed synaptic weights from observed fixed responses
rows.supported_result: Some weights can be constrained across a solution ensemble, while equal observed fixed points leave stability unidentified.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Parameter-space geometry is not anatomy; threshold-linear/norm assumptions and orthogonality limits do not supply the application contract.

rows.relation: Human assembly participation and coarse spatial enrichment
rows.where_it_enters: Observed co-firing, phase order, drift and anatomical recording categories
rows.supported_result: Flexible participation and ordered firing relate to memory, with spatial enrichment under some reference comparisons.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Incomplete recordings, coarse spatial categories and observational effects do not provide a microscopic semantic metric or a selected timing/learning mechanism.

rows.relation: Cognitive response maps versus anatomical neuron maps
rows.where_it_enters: Clustering preferences in a sampled input space
rows.supported_result: Grid-like fields can arise from the distribution and geometry of experienced inputs without supplying neuron positions.
rows.unresolved_transfer: Learning preferred stimulus centers differs from fixed semantic-coordinate roles; no recurrent sparse-learning benefit is established.

mechanism_comparison.current_boundary: The literature contains meaningful benefits of particular spatially organized mechanisms, and meaningful nonspatial recurrence examples. Neither class yet validates a distance rule for the current fixed-role, bounded-slot semantic CC. This is an unresolved transfer question, not a proof that geometry cannot help.

final_critical_review.representation: The map diagnostics concern10240polarity input profiles, not614400individual contextual cells. Orthogonal coordinate labels and correlated token-response columns are compatible. H41 does not select whether probability neutrality applies to proposals or retained edges.
final_critical_review.positive_controls: Retain fixed-feedforward recurrent learning (LOC186), the conditional spatial and nonspatial persistence alternatives (LOC234), and positive task-dependent geometric pruning results (LOC257). None is presented as a matched implementation of all application requirements.
final_critical_review.map_bounds: The cone proof uses distinct positions, strict closest-k membership and one excluded opponent. Half-open60degree cones make the angle strictly below60degrees; the farthest selecting point has at least k closer eligible points if the stated bound is exceeded. The loose bound does not explain the full map loss.
final_critical_review.map_numerics: Float64 direct coordinate differences reproduce both top16recall means; cross-seed overlap is invariant to rigid transformations. The objective trace is before each update and is not a convergence certificate. Uniform-eligible mean correlation provides a positive association baseline.
final_critical_review.temporal_information: Equal-occupancy reversed cycles can share instantaneous statistics. This limits an instantaneous-only learner; recurrent history may already distinguish them, so the example does not reject all Hebbian learning or require new bookkeeping.
final_critical_review.authority: Recommendations remain discussion material. Existing dimension neutrality, signed roles, rejected shared-position mechanism, staticSoA capacity and human decision history are preserved.

research_question_assessments.question: Does biological proximity explain desired computation, material wiring economy, development, or a mixture? What causal controls distinguish these?
research_question_assessments.assessment: Biological locality mixes physical opportunity, wiring economy and dynamical/learning effects. Positive geometric comparisons exist, but their controls and representation freedom differ; none transfers a physical metric to the assigned semantic roles.

research_question_assessments.question: Which recurrent assembly, sequence and metastable dynamics can arise without physical geometry, and what learning/stability assumptions do they require?
research_question_assessments.assessment: Nonspatial models support learned selective recurrence, state switching and sequence retrieval under explicit assumptions. Fixed input roles are compatible with recurrent learning. No reviewed model establishes all three application regimes with the current sparse precision/capacity contract.

research_question_assessments.question: What experimental evidence distinguishes functional connectivity selection from soma distance and neurite overlap within cortical microcircuits?
research_question_assessments.assessment: Matched functional/anatomical measurements distinguish neurite opportunity from synapse conversion and feature selectivity. Slice distance estimates also depend on cell class and sampling/detection. These are conditional biological findings, not application distance laws.

research_question_assessments.question: Which spatial effects depend on delays, dendritic nonlinearities or local inhibition, rather than graph adjacency alone?
research_question_assessments.assessment: Delay, slow currents, inhibition and dendritic resource/integration models have distinct mechanisms. Their effects cannot be inferred from pair distance alone; supplied afferent order or shared resources are additional assumptions.

research_question_assessments.question: What do fixed-coordinate dense signed embeddings permit us to infer about neuronal relations, without assigning semantic nearness to dimension labels?
research_question_assessments.assessment: Full-table measurements reveal dense, distribution-sensitive, polarity-sensitive associations without any dimension-label metric. Local maps depend on the chosen statistic and optimizer. Their neighborhood changes do not establish a task-level failure or a new neuron geometry.

research_question_assessments.question: What evidence would justify retaining no added distance rule, and what evidence could falsify that provisional outcome?
research_question_assessments.assessment: The review supports leaving additional geometry unselected while clarifying the learned temporal relation. A future geometric proposal could change that assessment by demonstrating a useful effect under preserved semantic roles and fairly matched resources/dynamics. The review does not prove geometry can never help.

research_question_assessments.question: How do finite degree, hubs, sparse capacity, pattern overlap and state-dependent activity alter the transfer of published results?
research_question_assessments.assessment: Allocated slots, occupied directed degree, strength, ranking popularity and active fraction are different. Heterogeneous degree and pattern overlap limit uniform-degree transfers; input-ranking hubs can arise from the statistic without biological meaning.

research_question_assessments.question: Which biological analogies require a representational change inconsistent with the current model?
research_question_assessments.assessment: Learned sensory/hidden maps, anatomical E/I taxonomy, dendritic ordering and alternate encodings cannot silently replace the fixed semantic-coordinate/polarity roles. Contextual recurrent activity may still be learned within those roles.

review_limits: Source cards identify full, partial and abstract-only scopes; source count does not mean every paper was fully read.
Queued references remain potential further reading. Completion denotes the requested sustained investigation and synthesis, not exhaustive coverage or scientific closure.
No author experiment was independently reproduced; public source inspection and independent analytical/input-table calculations have distinct labels.
No SNN application implementation or acceptance run was performed.
